commit_message: Add ADR 0121 Graph and UI adapters
pr_title: GameEngine: connect Graph and UI authoring adapters
pr_body:
## Summary

Connects the ADR 0121 shared semantic Graph and declarative UI authoring services to Editor-attached MCP and headless CLI adapters.

The live Editor remains authoritative: MCP mutations use the active document session, participate in Editor dirty/undo state, and do not write project files directly. CLI mutations use ProjectRoot-confined file selection and the same shared service semantics.

GraphView presentation/layout mutation remains intentionally separate under ADR 0016 and is not folded into semantic Graph transactions. Persisted Graph/UI formats and Stable IDs are unchanged.

Includes adapter-equivalence coverage for CLI mutation diffs and persistence.
